name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 2 – alinéa 1 – point 4 – sous-point a; Article 29 bis – paragraphe 1 – alinéa 1 - Am 362
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: ‘Parent undertakings of a group which, on their balance sheet dates, exceed the average number of 3000 employees and a net turnover of EUR 900 000 000, on a consolidated basis, during the financial year, shall include in the consolidated management report information necessary to understand the group’s impacts on sustainability matters, and information necessary to understand how sustainability matters affect the group’s development, performance and position.’;
